EC1: indications [AND] to dual antiplatelet therapy [NOT] other than atrial fibrillation [OR] or left atrial appendage occlusion at the time of enrollment [OR] or predicted appearance of such indications within the duration of the trial (eg. coronary artery disease)
EC2: indications [AND] to anticoagulation at the time of enrollment [OR] or predicted appearance of such indications within the duration of the trial (eg. pulmonary embolism)
EC3: known allergy to clopidogrel [OR] or acetylsalicylic acid precluding its administration as specified by the protocol
EC4: any known inborn or acquired coagulation disorders
EC5: poor tolerance [OR] of or technical difficulties [AND] with performing transesophageal echocardiography
EC6: peridevice leak [AND] >5mm on transesophageal echocardiography study preceding enrollment
EC7: left atrial thrombus [AND] on transesophageal echocardiography study performed after successful left atrial appendage closure but before enrollment
EC9: participation in other clinical studies with experimental therapies at the time of enrollment and preceding 3 months
EC10: chronic kidney disease stage [OR] IV and V
EC11: women who are pregnant [OR] or breast feeding; women of childbearing potential who do not consent to apply at least to methods of contraception. This criterion does not apply to postmenopausal women
